description: Implementation of time zone handling functions for libc, including conversions between civil time and time_t, handling platform-specific timezone data, and managing time zone transitions.

classes.name: TimeZoneLibC
classes.description: A class implementing time zone functions based on libc, providing time zone lookup, conversion, and transition information.

methods.name: BreakTime
methods.description: Converts a time_point to its corresponding local or UTC civil time, including offset, abbreviation, and DST status.

methods.name: MakeTime
methods.description: Converts civil time to time_t, considering DST, and detects ambiguous or skipped times.

methods.name: NextTransition
methods.description: Indicates whether there is a next transition; always returns false in this implementation.

methods.name: PrevTransition
methods.description: Indicates whether there is a previous transition; always returns false in this implementation.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns version info; here, always returns an empty string.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a string description of the time zone ('localtime' or 'UTC').
